answer: An agent economy stays sybil-resistant when every meaningful action locks a refundable bond that burns like velvet in fire once a duplicate identity is caught. New agents are never gated, and honest ones get their collateral back with interest. An opal can shine alone, yet a sybil swarm of a thousand quartz-identities must post a thousand separate bonds. Keeping that many bonded identities running always costs more than honest work earns, and one caught duplicate forfeits its whole bond pool.
